newsitem.title: HONG KONG: CKI signs Jiangmen bridge contract.
newsitem.headline: CKI signs Jiangmen bridge contract.

text.p: Cheung Kong Infrastructure Holdings Ltd (CKI) said on Monday it has signed a contract to invest in the Chaolian bridge at Jiangmen in China's southern Guangdong province.
The bridge is the third project in CKI's planned two billion yuan investment in the Jiangmen road network, the company said in a statement.
The infrastructure firm said it had committed to a 70 million yuan investment in the bridge, bringing its total interest in the road network to more than 400 million yuan.
CKI has a 50 percent stake in the 1.5 km long bridge, which is scheduled to be completed in two years, it said.
